editorialRead.dek: Agent Pulse filtered 27 included projects down to 3 items worth finite newsroom attention. The queue protects attention; it does not declare winners.

editorialRead.caveat: Source-code motion and article coverage are collected. GitHub issue flow, PR review timing, community discussion, and private backlog signals are not.

dailyInsight.headline: Audit whether an agent workflow leaves a restart-safe review record
dailyInsight.insight: Qwen Code's merged workflow-state change records terminal lifecycle events, phase visits, dispatch dependencies, retry lineage, and a reconstructed snapshot. Builders of multi-agent workflows should audit whether their own restart path preserves that topology, not merely logs and final text, before trusting an operator to decide what can be rerun after a process dies.
dailyInsight.mechanism: PR #9034 adds a structured runtime model for workflow execution. The persisted snapshot projects terminal registry state into a JSON record that includes source-run lineage, phase visits, dispatch traces and dependencies, events, logs, token accounting, result, and error state; `/workflows` can rebuild a terminal task from that snapshot after the CLI restart boundary.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: A workflow's final output cannot on its own say which branch ran, which predecessor a retry came from, or whether a missing result is a cancellation, a failure, or an unfinished dispatch. The recommended audit is a bounded design and failure-path exercise, not a claim that a released Qwen Code build or every agent runtime has this behavior.

actions.audience: Builder or operator responsible for a multi-agent workflow that may be restarted or retried
actions.label: Inspect one terminal workflow record after a controlled restart
actions.instruction: In a disposable workflow with harmless tools, complete or deliberately cancel a run that has at least two phases and one dependent subagent dispatch. Restart the host process, then inspect the persisted record. Verify that it identifies the prior run, phase visits, dispatch order or dependencies, terminal state, and error or result without inferring those facts from an unstructured log. Record any effect whose completion would still be uncertain before allowing an automatic retry.
actions.effort: 30–60 minutes for a disposable run and persistence-path inspection

receipts.title: feat(core): expose workflow execution state (#9034)
receipts.supports: Shows the public merged change across the workflow registry, runner, orchestrator, snapshots, command surface, and focused tests.

receipts.title: PR #9034: expose workflow execution state
receipts.supports: States that the change records run and step lifecycle events, persists journal state, reconstructs snapshots, and exposes cancellation and retention primitives.

receipts.title: Persisted workflow snapshot implementation at commit 63fe7c174
receipts.supports: Shows the terminal-snapshot schema, restart-oriented whole-run summary, and persisted fields used for phase, dispatch, event, lineage, result, and error reconstruction.

confidence.basis: A fresh public merge, its public PR description, and the pinned snapshot implementation agree on one narrow restart-boundary mechanism. The recommended audit is deliberately limited to a disposable workflow and does not depend on release availability.

dailyInsight.limitation: These public main-branch sources and tests do not establish that a released Qwen Code build exposes the workflow surface, that every snapshot write succeeds, that an active run remains inspectable after a crash, or that another runtime shares its persistence model.
dailyInsight.falsifier: Revise or withdraw this call if a public end-to-end restart path demonstrates that phase, dispatch, and lineage data are not actually reconstructed for a completed or cancelled workflow, or if the stored record cannot distinguish a retry's predecessor from a new run.
dailyInsight.watchNext: Watch for release documentation and a public restart reproduction that exercises an interrupted dependent dispatch, shows what remains uncertain about an external effect, and names the supported recovery choice.
